messages:
ellie_cs: FYI TidalHealth just opened a private model onboarding request — they need to serve a de-identified clinical summarizer with PHI allowed in VPC. Copy of their initial ask below.

 tidal-dev: Hi Redwood — we built an internal summarizer (13B) that outputs structured SOAP notes. Need private deployment in our VPC, HIPAA-ready, KMS integration, and ability to roll out canary to 5% traffic. Also want evals for hallucination rate on diagnoses and an MLOps webhook for alerts. ETA ~6 weeks. Any blockers?

 asha_se: Thanks — can you share model artifact (hf url or container) + tokenizer details? Also quick q: expected RPS and max sequence length?

 tidal-dev: artifact: s3://tidal-models/soap-13b.tar.gz; tokenizer: huggingface/soap-tokenizer-v1; expected peak RPS ~40, typical 10; max seq len 2048. Will provide sample prompts.

 tom_solutions: Noted. Two ops items: (1) Private deployment + KMS + audit logs — doable but we need executed BAA and network details; (2) Safety/regression evals — we can run Redwood's safety harness but will need either a customer-labeled eval set or permission to run proxy tests. Recommend initial canary on Dedicated then cut over to customer's VPC. @priya_privacy will confirm PHI gating details.

 priya_privacy: We'll need a signed BAA before any model or logs containing PHI are stored in Redwood systems. For evals, customer-supplied masked test set is preferred. If they cannot share PHI, ask them to provide a synthetic test set retaining realistic PHI patterns (MRN formatting, DOB distribution). We also require role-based access controls and a list of engineers who will access the deployment.

 asha_se: Action items: 1) Request BAA + deploy window from customer, 2) Request eval set or approval to generate synthetic evals, 3) Engineering to size nodes for a quantized 13B with 2048 tokens. Tom, can infra size? @deploy-bot — please open a ticket.

 deploy-bot: New ticket created: RED-4621 — TidalHealth private model onboarding (13B SOAP). Assignee: tom_solutions. SLA target: 14 days to canary.

 tom_solutions: I'll start sizing. Note: quantized 4-bit will likely fit on 1-2 A100s for moderate batch sizes but KV cache for 2048 tokens matters. @asha_se can you coordinate model transfer and run a smoke inference test (sample prompt below)?

 asha_se: Will do. Sample prompt I'll use in smoke test:
```
Patient: 65M with chest pain, history of HTN and DM2. Generate SOAP note and highlight any missing info.
```

 tidal-dev: Uploading artifact now, will share presigned link and contact for BAA signature by EOD. Also: any constraints on log retention for PHI? We want audit logs but limit retention to <30d if possible.

 priya_privacy: Default minimum audit log retention for healthcare is 90 days per our compliance baseline. We can discuss shorter tiers in the contract but need legal sign-off. Also confirm that access to raw output logs that contain PHI is restricted to specific roles only.

 ellie_cs: Timeline check: customer to send artifact + BAA today; Redwood to provide initial canary plan, cost estimate, and eval options by Wed. I'll run weekly syncs. :calendar_with_three_dates:

 asha_se: Quick architecture question — do we want to run on Redwood Private control plane with VPC peering, or do a customer-hosted private agent inside their VPC? VPC peering is requested by customer but note it can add network complexity. We'll include network throughput tests in smoke.

 tom_solutions: Agreed. Practical plan: spin up Dedicated in same region for the 5% canary to validate model behavior and latency, then transition to customer VPC once network and KMS integration validated. That reduces blast radius.

 tidal-dev: Thanks — uploading now, presigned link will be dropped in this thread in a few mins. Also will prepare a small labeled eval set (10-20 examples) for hallucination checks.

 ellie_cs: Acked. If anyone wants to join tomorrow's sync at 11am PT I'll send calendar invite. I'll track RED-4621 and send a summary after the initial canary plan is ready.

 asha_se: I'll run the smoke once we have the artifact. Heads-up: we may need a small tokenization patch for that tokenizer version.

 tom_solutions: Will validate GPU sizing and KV mem; tagging infra docs.

 priya_privacy: Please hold on any retention changes until legal reviews the BAA clauses.

 tidal-dev: Understood — thanks everyone.

 ellie_cs: Closing thread for now — will follow up after the artifact + BAA arrive. End of thread.
